mentions.name: LLM-narrated MUD-style storytelling system
mentions.description: A storytelling system that fuses interactive fiction / MUDs with the strengths of LLMs. The world model is entirely deterministic, while the LLM interprets the player's actions and narrates the game and NPCs.
mentions.source_excerpt: Since January I've been working on a storytelling system that fuses what I think is the best of interactive fiction / MUDs with the strengths of LLMs. The world model is entirely deterministic, but the LLM interprets the player and narrates the game and NPCs.
mentions.author: enduser
